limits: Pure offline controls with synthetic doubles in temporary directories. No host, model, paid route or network was used, and nothing native ran. Ticks are supplied by the caller. Operators, identities, retention ticks and evidence hashes are caller-asserted: records prove binding, not authenticity. The T010 dependency is still open in tasks.md; this library adds no CLI, plugin or MCP surface. Staged profiles cannot select model or route settings, because verify_profile is called without an approved-settings list, so such profiles refuse. Retention duration and purge schedule remain an open contract question (section 10/12): there is no default, and nothing is deleted except by an explicit human purge. The bounds MAX_PRIVATE=64, MAX_PRIVATE_BYTES=65536, MAX_PREVIOUS=16, MAX_JOURNAL=256 and STOP_RESERVE=8 are module-local and provisional. Writes are serialized by a POSIX flock and use temp-file, fsync and rename. The state file is written before the registry. A crash between the two shows registryConsistent false and is repaired by repeating a stop or by a human save_registry. A same-user process swapping a directory between the layout check and a write is outside the contract section 7 threat model. Concurrent installs on one root, and recover racing an install, are not handled. A rolled-back profile's bytes are deleted by recover as unreferenced. docs/tooling/HARNESSING.md is listed as an output of SPEC-049/T009 evidence; that pin was already stale (a later commit changed the file) and T011 names the file as a target, so a section was appended. Pre-PR adversarial, functional, quality and simplification reviews were run by Claude subagents and are not independent Luna review; the counterfactual pass was a local mutation script.
method: Actual offline unittest execution plus a local guard-removal (mutation) pass
outcome: Offline, disabled-by-default lifecycle library. It provides human opt-in installation for the one supported host; linked profile migration with byte-verified rollback/downgrade and retained prior profiles; expiry gating; source/host/model/tool/policy drift detection with human requalification; a T009 canary against the persisted T013 registry; incident stop with registry rollback and human clear; registry plus T008 revocation propagation; explicit retention with human purge; and verifiable uninstall with a hash receipt. Interrupted install, migration, purge and uninstall are atomic or completed by recover. Fresh, upgrade, downgrade, interrupted, unsupported-host and future/old state-format paths are tested. activate always refuses, and no result carries execution authority.
